en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a row of multi‑story residential and town buildings on the left and a wide street with pedestrians and people pushing handcarts. Trees line the right side of the street. In the distance a large church or civic building with a tall tower and dome rises above the rooftops. Printed caption text at the top right reads "Nossen i. Sa. — Bismarckstraße".
